title: AppSettings
description: Global, app-wide settings stored at ~/.maiestro/settings.json. This schema is the hand-written specification for the file format; the Rust AppSettings struct must conform to it (a unit test enforces the two stay in sync). Every field is optional — a missing or partial file falls back to defaults. Unknown fields are tolerated so files written by a newer app version still load in an older one.

window.title: WindowSize
window.description: Persisted size (logical pixels) of the menu-bar popover. Machine-managed — saved when the popover hides, restored before it shows. Not user-editable in the Settings form. null/absent = use the tauri.conf.json default.

settings_window.title: WindowSize
settings_window.description: Persisted size (logical pixels) of the Settings window. Machine-managed — saved when it loses focus/closes, restored before it shows. Not user-editable in the Settings form. null/absent = use the tauri.conf.json default.

width.description: Settings window width in logical pixels.

height.description: Settings window height in logical pixels.

theme.description: Chosen UI appearance. "system" follows the macOS dark/light setting (resolved via prefers-color-scheme). null/absent means "system".

tool_paths.title: ToolPaths
tool_paths.description: Explicit paths for the CLIs mAIestro Code runs itself. Leave a field empty to auto-detect (login-shell PATH, then known install locations); set one to pin a specific binary — useful when the app, launched from /Applications with a minimal PATH, can't find a tool.

claude.description: Used for AI drafting of issues, labels, and PRs, and to launch Claude in a spawned worktree's VS Code terminal. Leave empty to auto-detect.

git.description: Used for worktree creation and branch checks. Leave empty to auto-detect.

code.description: The VS Code command-line tool, used to open spawned worktrees. Leave empty to auto-detect.

terminal_font_family.description: Font for the terminal in a spawned worktree's VS Code window. A Nerd Font renders Claude Code's box and powerline glyphs correctly; leave empty to use the default.

launch_at_login.description: Whether to launch mAIestro Code automatically when the user logs in, via a per-user LaunchAgent (~/Library/LaunchAgents/mAIestro.plist). Toggled in the Preferences panel. null/absent = false.

onboarding_completed.description: Machine-managed. Whether the one-time onboarding flow has been completed; set once (to true) when the onboarding dialog is dismissed, so it never reappears. Gates the first-run onboarding window. Not user-editable in the Settings form. null/absent = not yet onboarded.

update_check.title: UpdateCheck
update_check.description: Machine-managed state of the background update check (the unauthenticated poll of this app's GitHub Releases, every ~12 hours). Not user-editable in the Settings form. null/absent = never checked, nothing dismissed.

checked_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the last successful check. Decides whether the next launch checks right away (absent or older than the interval) or waits.

latest_version.description: Semver of the latest published release seen by the last successful check, e.g. "0.4.0" (tag without the v).

latest_published_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp GitHub reported for that release's publication; the banner waits until this is at least 5 days old.

dismissed_version.description: The version whose update banner the user dismissed. The banner stays hidden for exactly that version and returns for any newer one.
